name: Group Content Default Menu
description: Auto-configures group menus for group content.
project_description:
Group Content Default Menu 
 This module lets you configure the default menu links to add to the menu on a group's page, for any group type.

 Setup 
 
 Open the page for the group type (for which you want to define a default group content menu) and go to the content tab. Alternatively, select the "Set available content" operation for any group type. 
 Install exactly ONE group content menu plugin for the group type, and enable the checkbox for: Automatically create a menu when a group is created. 
 Install the Group Content Default Menu plugin. 
 In the plugin's configuration page, set the default links to use for this group type's menus and finish installing the plugin. 
 Once you create a new group of this group type, the group's menu will be auto-populated with the default links you've configured. To change the default menu links for a group type, simply Customize the plugin on the group type's Content tab. Changes will only apply to new groups created, not existing groups.
